observations.gap: Replacement context supplies original source colors/subtypes/card types to permanent checks but player protection still receives only sourceId/casterId. Returned source may be read instead of original visit.
observations.next: Use the existing snapshot-aware player protection API with an authoritative original source view; preserve original ability controller separately from source snapshot controller for EachOpponent. Cover player scope colors/subtypes/card types/EachOpponent on live/departed/returned sources.

observations.gap: Supertype and aura checks read present sourceId directly despite known original source history. Aura-source abilities also need a distinct targeting/attachment contract; merely having an Aura source is not proof the effect is attaching.
observations.next: Trace original-source supertype and spell-Aura semantics before a new internal contract. Do not extend protected resolver without specific authorization; any supporting helper change must preserve accepted callers and original tests.

observations.gap: chosenPlayerTarget is computed and passed into validateObjectTarget but dropped on its battlefield branch. Graveyard branch already forwards it.
observations.next: Carry targetPlayerId into PredicateContext for battlefield requirements and prove both replacement player and dependent permanent relations. Do not infer optional groups from flattened targets.

observations.gap: Source-relative identity comparisons use entityId only, so a returned source visit can be mistaken for the original source.
observations.next: Review source-relative predicate environment across permanent/card/spell requirements using original ObjectRef. Add tests separating source instance from chooser and controller; preserve current-original projection and departed-source snapshot semantics.

Mode/splice/division final views from authoritative groups
Serialized server-authored option suspension with stale/wrong-player rejection
BecomesTarget/ward stack identity and original-controller tests
All required regressions plus original-artifact receiving after source changes
